map.Code 39 是最早的字母数字条码之一：每个字符用 9 个元素（5 条 4 空: Code 39 is one of the earliest alphanumeric barcodes: each character uses 9 elements (5 bars and 4 spaces), exactly 3 wide and 6 narrow — hence the name "three of nine". The wide-to-narrow ratio is typically 2:1 to 3:1, and a larger ratio is easier to read. Its character set covers A–Z, 0–9, space, and - . $ / + %, with * serving as both start and stop character. Standard Code 39 does not mandate a check digit; a Mod 43 check can be used when required. Because its density is low (roughly 9–16 modules per character), it suits industrial and logistics scenarios where label space is plentiful.
map.工业与资产标签：Code 39 支持大写字母与数字、无需校验位即可打印，广泛用于: Industrial and asset labels: Code 39 supports uppercase letters and digits and can be printed without a check digit, so it is widely used for equipment asset tags, warehouse shelving, and military LOGMARS labels.
map.需要 Mod 43 校验的场景：标签内容较长或打印质量不稳定时，可开启 Mod: Where a Mod 43 check is warranted: for longer label content or unstable print quality, enable the Mod 43 check digit — sum the values of all characters, take the remainder modulo 43, and append the character matching that remainder. This catches most misreads.
map.输入数字串（如 `123456789`）→ 渲染 CODE39 条码图形；请按规: Enter a numeric string (e.g. `123456789`) → renders a CODE39 barcode image; follow the prescribed length and check-digit rules.
map.Code 39 一定要加 * 号吗？: Must Code 39 always include the * character?
map.标准 Code 39 不强制校验位；需要时可用 Mod 43。与 EAN/UPC: Standard Code 39 does not mandate a check digit; a Mod 43 check can be used when needed. Unlike EAN/UPC, its check digit is optional and the application decides whether to enable it — which is why the same data can differ by one character in length between two systems.
map.标准 Code 39 只有大写 A–Z、0–9、空格与 - . $ / + %: Standard Code 39 covers only uppercase A–Z, 0–9, space, and - . $ / + % — 43 characters in total. Lowercase requires Extended Code 39 (two characters combined to represent one ASCII character), which lengthens the barcode noticeably. If lowercase support is mandatory, Code 128 is the better choice.
